content.text:
All stages pass. Foundry fuzz: 100k runs green. Halmos: 117 symbolic paths, all invariants proven.

`bid()` enforces: not-finished, nonzero amount, within auction window, pulls ERC20 via `transferFrom`, accumulates into per-bidder `bids` mapping, tracks `_maxBidder`. `finishAuction()` enforces: not-finished, past `endTime`, at least one bid; then flips `_finished`, transfers the NFT to `_maxBidder`, returns winner. Ghost state in the test tracks bids identically, so the `ghost_max_bidder == ghost_winner == nft.ownerOf(id)` invariant holds.

result:
All stages pass. Foundry fuzz: 100k runs green. Halmos: 117 symbolic paths, all invariants proven.

`bid()` enforces: not-finished, nonzero amount, within auction window, pulls ERC20 via `transferFrom`, accumulates into per-bidder `bids` mapping, tracks `_maxBidder`. `finishAuction()` enforces: not-finished, past `endTime`, at least one bid; then flips `_finished`, transfers the NFT to `_maxBidder`, returns winner. Ghost state in the test tracks bids identically, so the `ghost_max_bidder == ghost_winner == nft.ownerOf(id)` invariant holds.
